environment.description: ECS Fargate task in private subnet with awsvpc networking. Container task definition specifies linuxParameters.capabilities.drop including CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN. The service is fronted by an internal ALB with an HTTP listener (port 443) configured with desync mitigation mode set to 'strictest'. The ALB's strictest desync mode classifies requests with both Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding headers, requests with ambiguous Transfer-Encoding values, or malformed chunk sizes as 'Severely Malformed' and drops them at the load balancer before they reach the target. The task's security group only allows ingress from the ALB security group on port 5000. Additionally, the container runs with readOnlyRootFilesystem=true and the task has no network policy allowing egress to anything except the backend subnet CIDR on port 8080.

config.backend: gunicorn HTTP/1.1 with keep-alive and pipelining enabled
